report.summary: All tagged claims in the report draft are fully supported by the corresponding filing excerpts. Every number, year, name, percentage, and rupee figure matches the source material. No unsupported or wrong-source verdicts were found. The untagged claims are either observations of absence, inferences, or calculations not requiring direct citations. The report's sourcing is sound and accurate for the cited material.
